content_preview.title: LangChain Raises $300 Million Series C at $3 Billion Valuation Led by CapitalG as LangSmith Tops 7,000 Organizations
content_preview.summary: LangChain closed a $300 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation led by CapitalG, more than doubling its year-old valuation as LangSmith adoption grows.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

LangChain has raised a $300 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation led by CapitalG, with participation from Singapore's GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP, and Sapphire Ventures, according to [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/13/ai-agent-startup-langchain-hits-3b-valuation/). The round gives the agent-management startup a post-money valuation 2.4 times its $1.25 billion valuation from its October 2025 Series B round, according to [Dataconomy](https://dataconomy.com/2026/11/16/langch...
